## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest coherent solution.

## Related issue or milestone

Link the issue, approved milestone, or decision record.

## Change type

- [ ] Documentation or tutorial
- [ ] Bug fix with regression test
- [ ] Compiler, runtime, module, or CLI implementation
- [ ] VS Code extension
- [ ] Website or playground
- [ ] Repository or release process
- [ ] Approved language or public API change

## Language contract

- [ ] This change does not alter established language behaviour or public APIs.
- [ ] This change is owner-approved and has the required specification or ADR update.
- [ ] This change preserves Igbo Unicode, source locations, and diagnostic categories.

## Validation

List the exact commands run and their results. Do not mark a check complete if it
did not finish.

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run website:check` (when relevant)
- [ ] `npm run vscode:check` (when relevant)
- [ ] Direct CLI, runtime, module, or browser probes (when relevant)

## Checklist

- [ ] I read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/README.md`, and the relevant specification or ADR.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed behaviour.
- [ ] I updated documentation, examples, and tutorials where behaviour changed.
- [ ] I removed secrets, credentials, personal data, and unlicensed third-party material.
- [ ] I did not include generated build artifacts, dependency directories, logs, or packaged VSIX files.
- [ ] I reviewed the final diff and preserved unrelated work.
